title: Docs migration to the new site
transcript:
[00:00] Farah: The old docs platform contract ends on the 30th, and they won't extend month to month.
[00:07] Ivo: The new site is up. Search works, versioning works. It just has no content.
[00:13] Nkechi: How many pages are we talking about?
[00:17] Ivo: About three hundred on the old platform. Some of it hasn't been touched in two years.
[00:24] Farah: OK. Nkechi, can you migrate the docs to the new site by the 20th? That gives us ten days of slack.
[00:33] Nkechi: By the 20th, yes. I'll script the conversion and fix the tables by hand.
[00:39] Ivo: Redirects too, please. We have a lot of inbound links from forums.
[00:45] Nkechi: I'll generate a redirect map from the old URLs.
[00:49] Farah: Ivo, can you set up the redirect rules once Nkechi has the map?
[00:55] Ivo: Yes.
[00:59] Farah: And let's freeze edits on the old platform from the 16th.
[01:04] Nkechi: I'll post the freeze in the docs channel.
[01:08] Farah: Great, thanks.
